responses: Positional initializer: integration safety unproven. Read the merged member layout and audit every positional Options initializer against its intended fields. An inserted Boolean can silently redirect true while compiling successfully. Verify effective settings for the affected explicitly enabled configurations and their interactions. Defaults-OFF benches and perft do not cover that wiring. If the five-minute budget expires before those checks, report the precise gap and withhold a safe-integration claim.

Preset assignment: likely independent-setting overwrite. Establish the intended preset ownership, then check the complete effective options before and after applying a preset with TmSoftHardClamp and SmpV2 already enabled, individually and together. Check both command orders and switching presets. Tests asserting only preset fields miss collateral resets. If those flags are intended to remain independent, reproduce the loss, repair the assignment, and rerun focused regressions before acceptance.

Edited runner: provenance must be resolved. Preserve the binary, original output, both available runner versions, timestamps and hashes. Determine which runner version actually executed each invocation; a subsequent edit does not automatically change an already loaded process. Publish attributable results with their actual executed runner identity and disclose the later edit. Correct the old-hash record transparently if it is wrong. If executed provenance cannot be established, publish the evidence as provisional with runner identity unresolved and withhold acceptance; neither current-file hash nor old metadata proves execution identity.

Duplicate UCI advertisements and misleading echo: protocol/configuration defect. Inspect actual uci output and the declared option contract. Verify unique canonical advertisements with consistent types, defaults and allowed values. Exercise supported old/new aliases and their command ordering, checking the resulting effective settings and behavior against BundlePreset reporting. Passing OFF benches cannot establish protocol correctness. Resolve the ambiguity and misleading reporting, then repeat those focused checks.
